liked:
Positives : 
- 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station
- cooking facilities available.
- laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
disliked:
Negatives :
- no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance
- dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken.
- Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight.
- The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. 
- there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times.


Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

title: Very not recommended; looking for cheaper options and other choices
liked: Convenient location
disliked:
The system said check-in information would be sent before 3 PM, but for two days none of it arrived (different room types require re-check-in); had to go on-site and communicate with a video desk, and on the second day waited for a password to complete the check-in, which was very inefficient.

1) Compared to other hostels, you must provide all amenities yourself (towels, shower gel, shampoo) despite paying for the stay.
2) The room only has a central light; if you return late, there is no proper lighting and you can only use your phone to illuminate the room.
3) The sink in the bathroom has no counter space to place bottles, making usage very inconvenient—items can only be placed on the toilet.
These aren’t unreasonable requests, yet none of these are provided here.
Overall, I regret choosing this place; it is far worse than any hostel I’ve stayed in before and I do not recommend it.

title: Horrible
liked: Não gostei de absolutamente nada.
disliked: The hostel is dirty, messy and ugly. When you enter the hostel there is a cramped corridor full of luggage and there is no one to greet you. The receptionist is a remote attendant via a small screen, with no on-site manager to help. Entering the kitchen and common areas, things get much worse: everything is very dirty and chaotic, the kitchen is a mess and the fridges are so full it’s impossible to store even a bottle of water. I stayed in two rooms. The first room was freezing and there was no way to increase the air conditioning or complain to someone at the ghost hostel. The external bathroom, shared with the whole floor, was a complete mess—filthy. The second room was female-only, in what seemed to be an annex, and whenever someone walked by my bed would shake because the floor isn’t well supported. The bathroom was dirty too, but a bit less than the external bathroom, and the room smelled of mold. This was the worst experience I’ve had in a hostel. I don’t like leaving negative reviews because I don’t want to hurt anyone, but I can’t let others be misled as I was. Don’t trust the photos; the reality is very different and this hostel still has a long way to go to be considered bad.

Once you’re in your pod you can pretend you’re elsewhere. But in the bedroom it can be quite scary/overwhelming. There are too many people there and it doesn’t feel homely at all. It feels like we were all evacuated from war into a camp

I do not recommend this place.
